messages:
Anya (PM): quick sync — we shipped v1.2 yesterday. small uptick in errors but overall green. need a quick decision: focus next mini-iteration on immediate bug fixes, or finish feature X polish? what are non-negotiables for a rollback?
Matt (Eng): saw the same. error rate rose to ~2.1% on the chatbot endpoint for 10–15m after deploy. not widespread but affects a few enterprise customers.
Leo (Support): flagged 3 customers with sessions dropping. I opened tickets: CUST-112, CUST-117, CUST-121. customers asking for hotfix over new features.
Sara (Design): feature X polish is small UI tweaks and one accessibility fix. can be shipped in a patch if eng timelines allow.
Priya (Data): quick metric: median latency increased from 120ms -> 150ms for churned sessions; tail p95 up by ~80ms. can dig deeper if needed.
Matt (Eng): proposing criteria for rollback vs. cut: 1) persistent >3% error rate for >30m 2) >5 enterprise accounts impacted 3) rollback cost <30min to complete.
Anya (PM): agree. add customer-impact weighting: if product-critical customers are impacted, escalate immediate hotfix. otherwise prefer targeted patch.
Matt (Eng): operational plan: canary rollback path ready. steps:
```
- disable canary routing
- revert model variant to v1.1
- run smoke tests
- monitor for 15m
```
Matt (Eng): rollback dry-run took 12m in staging yesterday.
Leo (Support): if we roll back, please ping #support-run so we can update customers quickly.
Sara (Design): small opt: we can hide the new micro-interaction behind a flag for affected customers if that speeds mitigation.
Anya (PM): decision: short-term: prioritize P0 customer-facing bug fixes and enable canary rollback if errors cross thresholds. medium-term: schedule a 3-day mini-sprint for feature X polish + remaining bug list.
Priya (Data): will send a promptset slice to validate regressions and produce a quick scoreboard by EOD.
Matt (Eng): I'll create the rollback runbook in the repo and add a canary threshold alert in infra.
Anya (PM): owners: Matt = rollback/runbook, Leo = customer comms, Sara = feature flag, Priya = metrics. I'll add the mini-sprint ticket and coordinate prioritization with sales. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy v1.2 -> prod at 2026-03-21T18:34:12Z :rocket:
Anya (PM): thanks — will post the mini-sprint kickoff time once I sync with eng capacity. if anything changes, @matt please update here.
Matt (Eng): noted. starting the runbook doc now.
Leo (Support): I'll prepare a short template update for affected customers.
Sara (Design): prepping the flag quick patch, should be ready in ~6 hrs.
Anya (PM): perfect. checking off for now — we'll reconvene if alerts fire or new customer reports come in.
